models.name: dbnet_detect.ncnn.param
models.note: DBNet (m-i-t default detector). resize_aspect to 1024 (pad to 256 multiples); rectangular input avoids ncnn's 832-992 square crash band. fp16 storage (153MB); int8 quant drops all boxes so not used.

models.name: ocr_48px_ctc.ncnn.param
models.note: 48px CTC OCR on NCNN (parity/export_ocr_ncnn.py). Plain param: every layer at the net's global precision — the engine loads this one whenever the _mixed param can't be used (CPU without arm82 fp16, or fp16 storage turned off). Positional encoding is the second input (in1, T = floor(W/4) - 1), so any strip width works. Shares ocr_48px_ctc.ncnn.bin with the _mixed param.

models.name: ocr_48px_ctc_mixed.ncnn.param
models.note: Mixed-precision param, the default on arm82 (asimdhp) CPUs: backbone convs fp16, transformer + char_pred forced to fp32 via per-layer featmask 31=7, with an explicit Cast (fp16 -> fp32) between them. Only valid with fp16 storage on the CPU — elsewhere the Cast would read fp32 as fp16, so the engine falls back to the plain param. Same .bin as the plain param (weight order unchanged).

models.name: ocr_48px_ctc.ncnn.bin
models.note: Weights (fp16 storage, ~83 MB; the retired int8 ONNX was 44 MB). Shared by both OCR params — always ship it from the same conversion as the params.

models.name: mit_aot_fixed512.ncnn.param
models.note: AOT-GAN manga inpaint (m-i-t). Fully-convolutional; run at whole-page tile 768 by default.
